title: 절을 연결하기
objectives: 등위·종속 접속사로 절을 연결하는 방법을 익힌다
짧은 문장 두 개를 논리적으로 합친다

concept.summary: 긴 문장은 절과 절을 연결하는 능력에서 시작됩니다. and/but/so 같은 등위접속사와 because/although/if/when 같은 종속접속사를 구분하면 문장 확장이 쉬워집니다. TEPS 독해에서도 연결어가 논리 흐름의 신호입니다.
points: 콤마 사용은 절의 길이와 위치에 따라 달라진다

examples.en: She stayed home because she felt sick.
Although the test was hard, he finished on time.
If it rains, the event will be postponed.

checks.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "He left early ___ he had another appointment."
두 문장을 가장 자연스럽게 연결한 것은? "It was late. She kept working."
choices: It was late, so she kept working.
It was late, but she kept working.
It was late, because she kept working.
It was late, if she kept working.
checks.explanation: 늦은 시간과 계속 일한 것은 대조 관계이므로 but이 자연스럽습니다.

checks.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "___ you finish the report, we can leave."
다음 중 문법적으로 올바른 문장은?
choices: Because he was tired. He went to bed.
He went to bed because he was tired.
He went to bed, because of he was tired.
Because of he was tired, he went to bed.
checks.explanation: because 뒤에는 절(S+V)이 옵니다. Because만으로 문장을 끊으면 불완전합니다.

checks.question: "She will join us ___ she is free."에 알맞은 것은?
대조를 나타내는 연결로 알맞은 것은?
choices: I studied hard, so I passed.
I studied hard, and I passed.
I studied hard, but I failed.
I studied hard, because I failed.
checks.explanation: but은 기대와 다른 결과를 잇는 대조 접속사입니다.

checks.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "___ the delay, the project was completed."
checks.explanation: Despite 뒤에는 명사구가 옵니다. Although 뒤에는 절이 필요합니다.

checks.question: "I will call you when I arrive."에서 when절의 역할은?
checks.explanation: when I arrive는 주절의 시간을 나타내는 종속절입니다.

checks.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? "Take a map, ___ you may get lost."
checks.explanation: 그렇지 않으면(~하지 않으면)의 경고·선택 관계에서는 or가 자연스럽습니다.

checks.question: 다음 중 unless의 의미가 올바른 문장은?
choices: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
Unless you hurry, you will not be late.
Unless it is cheap, I will buy it.
checks.explanation: unless는 if not(~하지 않으면)입니다. 서두르지 않으면 늦는다는 뜻이 됩니다.
